integrity: The first iterates are independently derived as the scalar minimizers of the primal and normal residuals on the common first Krylov line. Their normal-residual norms share one variance factor, yielding an exact ratio. A sharp endpoint spectral-moment inequality produces the condition-number envelope, and a two-dimensional diagonal family attains equality. The original LSQR record inspected was month-resolved rather than day-resolved; the machine date uses the earliest exact day-resolved cited source instead of inventing a print day.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic first-step comparison for undamped, unpreconditioned LSQR and LSMR on full-column-rank real least-squares problems started from zero. It does not claim the same ratio at later Krylov dimensions, for rank-deficient extensions, or in finite precision.
title: Sharp first-step normal-residual separation between LSQR and LSMR
